# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Technical changes

- [ ] Data handling
- [ ] Target construction
- [ ] Feature engineering
- [ ] Model development
- [ ] Evaluation
- [ ] Robustness
- [ ] Documentation

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] No future information is used
- [ ] Temporal validation is preserved
- [ ] Metrics were regenerated
- [ ] Generated outputs were reviewed

## Risk and limitations

Describe any known risks, assumptions or limitations.

## Reviewer focus

List the specific decisions where reviewer feedback is most valuable.
